mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.total_score IS NULL THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN s.total_score < 60.00 AND ( SELECT prev.total_score FROM score prev JOIN course_arrangement prev_ca ON prev.course_arrangement_id = prev_ca.id WHERE prev.student_id = s.student_id AND prev_ca.course_id = ca.course_id AND prev_ca.semester = ca.semester AND ( COALESCE(prev.exam_time, prev.create_time) < COALESCE(s.exam_time, s.create_time) OR ( COALESCE(prev.exam_time, prev.create_time) = COALESCE(s.exam_time, s.create_time) AND prev.id < s.id ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(prev.exam_time, prev.create_time) DESC, prev.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) < 60.00 THEN 'RETAKE' WHEN s.total_score < 60.00 THEN 'MAKEUP' ELSE 'NORMAL' END
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, st.student_no, st.name as student_name, COALESCE(ca_cl.class_name, st_cl.class_name) as class_name, as derived_status, c.course_name, t.name as teacher_name, ca.semester FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON s.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN class ca_cl ON ca.class_id = ca_cl.id LEFT JOIN class st_cl ON st.class_id = st_cl.id LEFT JOIN course c ON ca.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ca.teacher_id = t.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.*, st.student_no, st.name as student_name, COALESCE(ca_cl.class_name, st_cl.class_name) as class_name, as derived_status, c.course_name, t.name as teacher_name, ca.semester FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON s.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN class ca_cl ON ca.class_id = ca_cl.id LEFT JOIN class st_cl ON st.class_id = st_cl.id LEFT JOIN course c ON ca.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ca.teacher_id = t.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.*, st.student_no, st.name as student_name, COALESCE(ca_cl.class_name, st_cl.class_name) as class_name, as derived_status, c.course_name, t.name as teacher_name, ca.semester FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON s.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN class ca_cl ON ca.class_id = ca_cl.id LEFT JOIN class st_cl ON st.class_id = st_cl.id LEFT JOIN course c ON ca.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ca.teacher_id = t.id WHERE s.course_arrangement_id = #{courseArrangementId} ORDER BY s.total_score DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN total_score >= 90 THEN '90-100' WHEN total_score >= 80 THEN '80-89' WHEN total_score >= 70 THEN '70-79' WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN '60-69' ELSE '0-59' END as score_range, COUNT(*) as count FROM score WHERE course_arrangement_id = #{courseArrangementId} GROUP BY score_range ORDER BY score_range DESC

SELECT st.id as student_id, st.student_no, st.name as student_name, AVG(s.total_score) as average_score, SUM(s.total_score * c.credit) / SUM(c.credit) as weighted_average, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(s.total_score) DESC) as rank FROM score s JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id JOIN course_arrangement ca ON s.course_arrangement_id = ca.id JOIN course c ON ca.course_id = c.id WHERE st.class_id = #{classId} AND ca.semester = #{semester} GROUP BY st.id, st.student_no, st.name ORDER BY average_score DESC
